note: Pre-survey checklist (CP-30). Drafted by the team, to be reviewed with Marsh: the hazards per facility type and the standards each is checked against. Bump `version` on any change; every saved checklist records it. v2: descriptions for Section 8's utility subsections, which showed as a bare heading.

template_details.7/Construction Narrative: Walls, roof, frame and floors, with their materials and combustibility; building age, height and any alterations
template_details.7/Construction Table: Each building's construction class, floor area, storeys and year built
template_details.7/Compartmentalization and Fire Division: Fire walls and separations, and whether openings in them are protected
template_details.7/Details on Combustible Construction: Combustible roof or wall panels, insulation and linings, and where they are
template_details.8/Overview: What the site is used for, its operating hours and occupancy
template_details.8/Key Processes: The main processes, and any that are hazardous
template_details.8/Key Machinery: Critical machinery and equipment, and how replaceable it is
template_details.8/Back-up Power: Generators or UPS, what they serve and how they are tested
template_details.8/Transformer details: Each transformer's type, rating, oil or dry type, and separation from buildings
template_details.8/Boilers: Each boiler's type, fuel and pressure, where it sits and how it is separated, and its combustion safeguards and inspection records
template_details.8/Refrigeration / Chillers / Cooling tow: Refrigeration plant and its refrigerant, chillers, and cooling towers with their construction and whether combustible fill is protected
template_details.8/Fuels and energy supplies: Fuels on site (gas, oil, LPG), how much is stored and where, and their emergency shut-offs
template_details.8/Process water: Where process water comes from, how it is stored and treated, and what operations stop without it
template_details.8/Compressed air: Compressors, their location and condition, and what operations depend on compressed air
template_details.8/Compressed gases: Gas cylinders and bulk tanks, what they hold, where and how they are stored and secured
template_details.8/Waste and effluent treatment: How waste and effluent are collected, stored and treated, and where combustible waste builds up
template_details.8/Other site services: Any other utility or service the site depends on, and what happens if it fails
template_details.9/Automatic Sprinkler Protection: Sprinkler system types, coverage and design density for each area
template_details.9/Special Extinguishing Systems: Gaseous, foam or other special systems, and what they protect
template_details.9/Water Supply Details: Water sources, tanks and mains feeding the fire protection
template_details.9/Water Supply Test Results: The latest water supply test: static and residual pressure, and flow
template_details.9/Fire / Booster Pump Details: Each fire pump's type, driver, rating and controller
template_details.9/Pump Flow Test Data: The latest pump flow test results
template_details.9/Fire Alarm Monitoring: Where alarms are monitored, and how quickly they are acted on
template_details.10/Location Details: The site's location, surroundings and access for the fire service
template_details.11/CCTV: CCTV coverage, recording and who monitors it

Distribution warehouse.name: Rack and high-piled storage
Distribution warehouse.search: rack storage height, flue spaces, commodity classification and in-rack sprinklers
Distribution warehouse.item: Check rack and high-piled storage heights, flue spaces and commodity classes against the sprinkler design

Distribution warehouse.name: Roofing materials
Distribution warehouse.search: roof construction, combustible insulated roof panels and roof covering
Distribution warehouse.item: Check the roof deck, covering and insulation, including any combustible-core panels

Distribution warehouse.name: Hazardous material storage
Distribution warehouse.search: storage of flammable liquids and hazardous materials, quantities, cabinets and separation
Distribution warehouse.item: Check where flammable or hazardous goods are stored, in what quantities, and how they are separated

Distribution warehouse.name: Forklift battery charging
Distribution warehouse.search: industrial truck battery charging areas, ventilation and separation from storage
Distribution warehouse.item: Check forklift charging is ventilated and kept clear of combustible storage

Cold store.name: Insulated sandwich panels
Cold store.search: insulated sandwich panel walls and ceilings with combustible cores
Cold store.item: Check the insulated wall and ceiling panels, their core material and any damage

Cold store.name: Ammonia refrigeration plant
Cold store.search: mechanical refrigeration machinery rooms, ammonia leak detection and ventilation
Cold store.item: Check the refrigeration plant room, leak detection and emergency ventilation

Cold store.name: Sprinklers in refrigerated areas
Cold store.search: dry pipe or preaction sprinklers for refrigerated and freezer storage
Cold store.item: Check the sprinkler systems in freezers and chillers are suitable for low temperatures

Cold store.name: Rack storage
Cold store.search: rack storage height, flue spaces and in-rack sprinklers
Cold store.item: Check rack heights, flue spaces and commodity classes against the sprinkler design

Chemical plant.name: Ignitable liquid storage and use
Chemical plant.search: ignitable and flammable liquid storage and process operations, containment and drainage
Chemical plant.item: Check how ignitable liquids are stored and handled, and how spills are contained and drained

Chemical plant.name: Reactive and hazardous chemicals
Chemical plant.search: hazardous materials storage, incompatible chemicals and separation
Chemical plant.item: Check hazardous and reactive chemicals are stored apart from incompatible materials

Chemical plant.name: Combustible dust
Chemical plant.search: combustible dust hazard analysis, dust collection and explosion protection
Chemical plant.item: Check for combustible dust build-up, dust collection and explosion protection

Chemical plant.name: Hot work
Chemical plant.search: hot work permit system and fire watch
Chemical plant.item: Check the hot work permit system and how it is enforced

Paper mill.name: Roll paper storage
Paper mill.search: roll paper storage height, banding and sprinkler protection
Paper mill.item: Check roll paper storage heights, arrangement and sprinkler protection

Paper mill.name: Paper dust and fibre
Paper mill.search: combustible dust and fibre accumulation, housekeeping and dust collection
Paper mill.item: Check for paper dust and fibre build-up on structure and equipment

Paper mill.name: Hot work
Paper mill.search: hot work permit system and fire watch
Paper mill.item: Check the hot work permit system and how it is enforced

Paper mill.name: Transformers
Paper mill.search: oil-filled transformer separation, containment and fire protection

Port terminal.name: Wharf and pier construction
Port terminal.search: marine terminal, pier and wharf construction and fire protection

Port terminal.name: Dangerous goods storage
Port terminal.search: hazardous materials and dangerous goods container storage and segregation

Port terminal.name: Flood and storm surge
Port terminal.search: flood and storm surge exposure and protection

Port terminal.name: Cranes and mobile equipment
Port terminal.search: industrial trucks and mobile handling equipment, refuelling and charging

Data centre.name: UPS batteries

Data centre.name: Gaseous suppression

Data centre.name: Generators and diesel storage
